column1: # Label cleaning, layer 1: pure spelling-variant groups (cleaning plan "Layer 1"; training/cleaning.py).
# "canonical<TAB>variant[<TAB>...]": the members are the same word in every context; every variant becomes the
# canonical (first) form. Matched case-insensitively on whole tokens, longest first. The canonical form is the one
# more frequent in the training pool's human references (normalized words, kept ids), ties to the term list's first
# form. Groups from the committed term lists' spelling variants (terms.variant_key), plus ok / okay and alright /
# all right. Contextual groups (back end / backend, front end / frontend) are layer 2 sets in choices.tsv.
# Left out: ptsd / p t s d (the references spell the letters out by convention; "PTSD" stays as written).
